chunks: And Sama'ah narrated from Abu Basir, from Abu Abdullah عليه السلام, who said:
I said to him: A man leaves for his family an expense provision of three thousand dirhams for the expenses of two years; is zakat due upon it?
He said: If he is present, then zakat is due upon it; and if he is absent, then there is nothing due on it.

key_terms.دِرْهَمٍ: a monetary unit of silver currency
key_terms.زَكَاةٌ: the obligatory alms-tax due on qualifying wealth
key_terms.شَاهِدًا: present and in attendance, not absent
key_terms.غَائِبًا: absent and away from the property
key_terms.نَفَقَةَ: maintenance or living expenses set aside for dependents

ai.seo_question: Is zakat due on money left for one's family expenses if the owner is absent?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling about zakat on money set aside for a family's maintenance. It distinguishes between the owner's being present and absent, indicating that zakat is due when he is present, but nothing is due when he is absent.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.1614 - Sama'ah narrated from Abu Basir, who reported from Abu Abdullah (Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as)). He said:
I asked him, "A man leaves his family with a provision of three thousand dirhams for two years' expenses. Is Zakat due on it?"
Imam (as) replied: "If he is present, Zakat is due on it. If he is absent, there is nothing due on it."
